original: Riveted co-driver door with a window net.
english: Riveted co-driver door with a window net.
russian: Клёпаная дверь пассажира с сеткой на окне.

original: Riveted driver door with a window net.
english: Riveted driver door with a window net.
russian: Клёпаная дверь водителя с сеткой на окне.

original: Mounts in place of an Echo Runner wheel. With all four modules, the lines and charged tanks the car flies; with an Echo or cold fusion battery it also floats on its cushion when switched off.
english: Mounts in place of an Echo Runner wheel. With all four modules, the lines and charged tanks the car flies; with an Echo or cold fusion battery it also floats on its cushion when switched off.
russian: Ставится вместо колеса Echo Runner. С четырьмя модулями, трубопроводами и заряженными баками машина летает; с аккумулятором Эхо или синтеза — ещё и висит на подушке заглушенной.

original: Hood of the Echo Runner. Protects the engine.
english: Hood of the Echo Runner. Protects the engine.

original: Glowing line that carries energy from the tanks to the antigravity modules. Fits only the Echo Runner.
english: Glowing line that carries energy from the tanks to the antigravity modules. Fits only the Echo Runner.
russian: Светящаяся магистраль: несёт энергию от баков к антиграв-модулям. Подходит только к Echo Runner.

original: Tank of Echo condensate (red energy). Mounts in the Echo Runner's trunk; two full tanks give about 20 minutes of flight, one works too. Cannot be mixed with a cold fusion tank.
english: Tank of Echo condensate (red energy). Mounts in the Echo Runner's trunk; two full tanks give about 20 minutes of flight, one works too. Cannot be mixed with a cold fusion tank.
russian: Бак эхо-конденсата (красная энергия). Ставится в багажник Echo Runner; два полных бака — около 20 минут полёта, работает и один. С баком холодного синтеза не смешивается.

original: A sealed cold fusion chamber: the reaction never stops and the charge never runs out. Works only in a pair: with two tanks in the Echo Runner's trunk the car flies without using energy, a single tank does not power it. Cannot be mixed with Echo tanks.
english: A sealed cold fusion chamber: the reaction never stops and the charge never runs out. Works only in a pair: with two tanks in the Echo Runner's trunk the car flies without using energy, a single tank does not power it. Cannot be mixed with Echo tanks.
russian: Запаянная камера холодного синтеза: реакция не гаснет, заряд не кончается. Работает только в паре: с двумя баками в багажнике Echo Runner машина летает без расхода, один бак её не питает. С баками Эхо не смешивается.

original: Mud tyre on a steel beadlock rim. Fits only the Echo Runner.
english: Mud tyre on a steel beadlock rim. Fits only the Echo Runner.
russian: Грязевая шина на стальном диске с бедлоком. Подходит только к Echo Runner.
